translation: The eight extraordinary vessels are: the Yin Wei, the Yang Wei, the Yin Qiao, the Yang Qiao, the Chong, the Ren, the Du, and the Dai. The Yang Wei arises at the confluence of all the yang [meridians], and from the outer ankle ascends traveling in the wei-[qi] division; the Yin Wei arises at the intersection of all the yin [meridians], and from the inner ankle ascends traveling in the ying-[qi] division, and so it is the general cord and outline of the whole body. The Yang Qiao arises in the middle of the heel (gen), follows the outer ankle, and ascends to the left and right of the body; the Yin Qiao arises in the middle of the heel, follows the inner ankle, and ascends to the left and right of the body, and so it makes the joints nimble and quick.
